name: tracearr
description: Query Tracearr's public API for media tracing and analytics. Skills-only, no MCP server required.

tracearr_url.title: Tracearr URL
tracearr_url.description: Tracearr base URL for its public API, e.g. http://localhost:3000 (no trailing slash).

tracearr_api_key.title: Tracearr API key
tracearr_api_key.description: Bearer token for the Tracearr API. Optional — omit if your Tracearr exposes its public API unauthenticated.
